The '''Pact of Almera''' was a treaty that was signed in [[899 BBY]]<ref name="Author's Cut" /> and shared its name with the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Almera system/Legends|Almera system]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> The pact confirmed the independence of the<ref name="Author's Cut" /> Inner Rim<ref name="EAOC Thyrsus">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Thyrsus system/Legends|Thyrsus system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]] from the planetary confederation known as the [[Echani Command]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

Thyrsus had rebelled against the authority of the [[Echani/Legends|Echani]] worlds known as the [[Six Sisters]] since the [[Begali Uprising]] of [[1154 BBY]], with numerous skirmishes being fought between the Echani and the [[Thyrsian special forces]] and their successor, the [[Sun Guard]], despite the celestial body [[Begali]] itself renewing ties with the Echani Command. Following the signing of the Pact of Almera, the Six Sisters once again experienced peaceful [[Time/Legends|times]], while the Sun Guard became known as a famed [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pact of Almera was originally meant to be introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned it was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the treaty was later released in [[2013]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from the book.<ref name="Author's Cut" />
